question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

The acommodation was spacious enough for the entire family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"acommodation"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"accommodation"**. The incorrect spelling lacks one "c".
 
• **English Meaning:** Accommodation refers to a place where someone can stay, live, or work, such as a room, house, or office. (रहने का स्थान)
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel offers comfortable accommodation for its guests.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enough** (पर्याप्त): Refers to having as much as is needed or required.

 
 
• **Example:** There is enough food for everyone at the party.
 
 
 
• **Entire** (पूरा): Refers to the whole or complete thing.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent the entire day working on her project.
 
 
 
• **Spacious** (खुला और बड़ा): Refers to a large area with plenty of space.
 
 
• **Example:** The apartment is spacious enough to accommodate a family of four.
